message.reasoning:
The trade went through, so now I own mortgaged Park Place plus Boardwalk, with 268 cash. Unmortgaging Park Place would cost 220, leaving only 48, and I can't build anyway until the whole set is unmortgaged and houses run 200 each—so cash gets dangerously tight while hotels loom on the board.

I weigh the risk against the upside: if Park Place stays mortgaged I collect no rent on it even though Boardwalk alone already pays double as a monopoly, but unmortgaging it nets 70 rent and I can always re-mortgage for 175 if I need cash fast. The risk feels manageable given railroads I could mortgage in a pinch, so I decide to unmortgage now rather than wait for more cash to build.
